status: Accepted release-one MXF scope; not implemented or cut over.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock that MXF scope in for Bella. Next, let's look at OMF headers. How do Media Composer, MDVX and current MediaMuster read them, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Accepts the preceding release-one MXF layout/admission/navigation/recovery scope, alongside already agreed field/damage/selective-retention rules. Starts OMF requirements review; no implementation or app cutover.

agreedBellaRules.family: Supported Avid-compatible OP-Atom, including third-party Avid files and verified qualifier variants 0/1/2/3. No generic OP1a expansion or unproven all-zero OP compatibility.
agreedBellaRules.headerAdmission: Closed and complete initial Header Partition at byte zero, validated under agreed damage/ownership rules. Status is not proof of sound bytes.
agreedBellaRules.navigation: Partition pack, recognized optional alignment Fill, Primer; checked HeaderByteCount enclosing region beginning at Primer key. Stop after that metadata region.
agreedBellaRules.storage: Bounded reads, checked file/enclosing extents, needed compact values/lookups; skip unneeded definitions/payloads safely. No fixed first-N-MiB cap or unchecked HeaderByteCount allocation; release temporary storage.
agreedBellaRules.compatibility: Preserve known version-1 byte layout and supported label/local-set/private forms. Actual minor1.2 must not be rejected by requiring1.3. Future incompatible major unsupported.
agreedBellaRules.unsupportedStates: Open or closed-incomplete initial header, run-in, absent/unsafe initial region and unsupported pattern contribute no MXF metadata in this first-release path. They are not all automatically damaged. Physical row and eligible independent PMR/MDB/filesystem facts remain.
agreedBellaRules.noAutomaticRecovery: No footer/RIP/later-copy search, EOF packet walk, essence/index decoding, repair or byte resynchronization merely for these columns.
agreedBellaRules.tradeoff: Does not recover metadata requiring later header copies or provisional recording state; deliberately narrower than broad OldScanner/toolkit structural navigation.
agreedBellaRules.separateDecisions: Source priority, extra header-opening reasons and MXF concurrency remain separate. No runtime implementation or app cutover.
agreedBellaRules.performance: Removes unconditional traversal beyond selected header in design; scan time/memory benefit remains unmeasured.
